crossRefs.note: After the plague, Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
translations.bsb: These were the clans of Reuben, and their registration numbered 43,730.
translations.kjv: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
translations.asv: These are the families of the Reubenites; and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
